pool_uses_creating_thread_identity: Current implementation pins threading.current_thread() during teardown; creator identity is inferred from caller, not stored at construction.
pool_refcount_argument: On CPython, tuple-list/snapshot/loop ownership does not itself add raw tkapp references. Refcount2 is one record element plus getrefcount temporary. Removing entry leaves loop/snapshot references to same tuple, finally released on this caller thread.
pool_deferred_scope: External peer variables/tracebacks may keep raw interpreter alive until later creating-thread sweep or process exit. Closed root retained by UI remains protected when UI dies on a worker.
uncovered_native_constructor_boundary: self.root = tk.Tk() assigns only after full Tk.__init__. Native creation may succeed and _loadtk/readprofile then raise, leaving failed root and raw tkapp only in preserved Tk traceback; teardown cannot pin absent self.root.
cleanup_exception_boundary: Constructor except calls _teardown then bare raise, so an unexpected cleanup exception masks the original. _retiring is set without finally reset; an interrupted cleanup prevents retry.
